name: Maxon Cinema 4D
note: From the Cinema 4D "Keyboard Shortcuts" page of the Maxon help. That page states "Mac users please press the CMD key instead of the CTRL key", so the mac chords are the Windows chords with Ctrl replaced by Cmd. Section headings are used as context; the "General" section is context "". Two-key entries such as "M S" (Bevel) or "N A" (Gouraud Shading) are sequence actions. Left out because the chord grammar cannot express them: every mouse binding (LMB/RMB/MMB, Alt+MMB camera moves, "Create marker in Timeline CTRL + LMB", "Replace material with another ALT + Drag&Drop", "Interactively change animation time J + LMB", the Sculpt Stencil T + mouse bindings and the MMB brush size/hardness drags); the modifier-only bindings ("Smoothing with all brushes SHIFT", "Invert brush effect CTRL", "Magnifying glass ALT", "Change parameter values faster/slower with arrows ALT or SHIFT"); "Scale (along Normals) M #" (# is not in the key set); and "Move Track by 1 pixel Arrow keys", "Switch symmetry modes ALT + X,Y,Z" and "Changing the views F1, F2, F3, F4, F5", which name several keys at once. Where the page lists two alternatives the first is kept (e.g. Bridge "B, M B" is kept as B). Four rows repeat a name already used in the same section with a different key and were dropped as ambiguous: "Go To Previous Key F", "Go To Start ALT + F", "Go To End ALT + G" and the second "Disconnect U D". "Delete" is documented as "Backspace/Remove" and "Jump to Start" as "Pos 1" (the Home key).
